text:
maya: Quick sync — finalizing staggered cutover plan for API v2. Timeline is TOMORROW 06:00 UTC start. Need owners for slices, last PRs merged by EOD, and smoke test owners. @diego @sara @aj
sara: I can own slice B (routes that hit dedicated infra). Will merge the shim removal PR by 18:00 PT.
diego: I’ll own slice A (public hosted endpoints). Can take canary + first rollback checks. PR #4281 is ready, just waiting CI flake fix.
aj: I’m on SDK updates. Will publish the canary of redwood-js: `redwood-js@v2.1.0-canary` at 05:30 UTC and announce breaking changes in the changelog.
liam: I’ll run the perf smoke tests and validate latency SLOs on canary traffic. Need the canary routing rules and token to hit the canary cluster.
maya: Great. Canary plan: 1% -> 5% after 30m -> 20% after 90m -> 100% after 4h, manual hold at each step. Flag name: `api_v2_cutover_gate`.
diego: Sounds good. Add a safety fallback: if error rate > 2% or latency p95 regresses > 30% we auto-fallback to v1. Are we wired into circuit-breaker metric?
maya: Yes — `cutover-fallback-policy` is configured in routing. Routing will switch to `model: api_v1_compat` if alert fires. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.com/dashboards/v2-cutover (perm: eng+release).
sara: Quick dependency note — Dedicated infra team needs the new header `x-rw-client-id` to be present or 401s will spike (we added stricter auth). We should add a client shim in the SDK to set it by default. @aj can you include?
aj: Yep, will add header shim to canary build. Example snippet I’ll ship: `headers['x-rw-client-id'] = headers['x-rw-client-id'] || process.env.RW_CLIENT || 'sdk-default'`.
liam: For smoke tests, can someone drop the canary token here when ready? Prefer ephemeral token with 2h TTL.
diego: I’ll create token `canary-slice-a-2745` and post in #secrets (rotated).
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for service=api-router image=prod-api:cutover-2745 at 2026-03-18T06:00:30Z (canary=1%).
maya: Reminder: SDK major bump must have compatibility doc and migration snippet in README. AJ, ping when publish is live so we can update quickstarts.
aj: Will ping here and send the publish link. Also tagging @sara for review of the header behavior.
sara: Review done. Minor nit: prefer `X-RW-Client-Id` casing in examples. Not blocking.
diego: CI flake fixed and PR merged. Tagging rollout owners: slice A: diego, slice B: sara, SDK & quickstarts: aj, smoke/perf: liam, monitoring: maya.
maya: Thanks. Final checklist: merge PRs ✅; canary SDK publish by 05:30 UTC ✅; token in #secrets ✅; deploy-bot confirming canary ✅; smoke results posted in this thread within 45m of each expansion.
liam: Will post smoke summary per slice as runs complete.
maya: If anyone cannot make the window — call it out now, otherwise we proceed.
sara: I’m good.
aj: Good from me.
diego: Good.
maya: OK rolling tomorrow. Leaving this thread as the single-source for cutover notes and quick rollbacks. Ping me directly if you need immediate help. :thumbsup:
